meta.jurisdiction: Kingdom of Spain (Castilla y León, Segovia)
governing_statutes: Convenio Colectivo Provincial de Hostelería de Segovia (BOCyL)
meta.framework: Institutional Data Room Audit & Model Integrity Verification

capex_total.name: Total Asset Acquisition & Rehabilitation CapEx
capex_total.statutory_source: Project Technical Due Diligence & Commercial Deeds

capex_input_vat_asset.name: Deductible Input VAT on CapEx Outlay (21%)
capex_input_vat_asset.statutory_source: Ley 37/1992 del Impuesto sobre el Valor Añadido (Art. 92-114)

senior_debt_principal.name: Senior Mortgage Loan Principal (70% LTV)
senior_debt_principal.statutory_source: Credit Committee Term Sheet (15Y French Amortization @ 3.50%)

initial_cash_buffer.name: Day-1 Mobilized Cash Cushion
initial_cash_buffer.formula: Total Mobilized (€938k) - Initial CapEx & VAT Outlays (€881.25k)

year1_revenue.name: Year 1 Gross Operating Revenue (90% Ramp-up)
year1_revenue.formula: Empirical INE Segovia Monthly Series (28.22% Occupancy * €1,500/day)
year1_revenue.statutory_source: INE Encuesta de Ocupación en Alojamientos de Turismo Rural (EOTR)

year1_dscr.name: Year 1 Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR)
year1_dscr.formula: CFADS / Annual Debt Service = (EBITDA - Tax) / PMT_Annual

revpar_year1.name: Year 1 Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR)
revpar_year1.statutory_source: Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry (USALI)

trevpar_year1.name: Year 1 Total Revenue Per Available Room (TRevPAR)
trevpar_year1.statutory_source: Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry (USALI)

unit_contribution_margin_eur.name: Unit Contribution Margin per Occupied Day
unit_contribution_margin_eur.formula: Daily Gross (€1,500) - F&B COGS (€157.5) - OTA Comm (€87.75) - Amenities (€35)

year1_cash_trough_balance.name: Year 1 Minimum Cash Balance at Trough
year1_cash_trough_balance.formula: Cumulative Day-1 Buffer + Net Monthly Inflows/Outflows at trough month

copula_clayton_cvar99.name: Clayton Copula Expected Shortfall (CVaR 99% DSCR)
copula_clayton_cvar99.formula: E[DSCR | DSCR <= VaR_99] under Clayton Archimedean Copula (theta=1.8)

recommended_dsra_sizing.name: Tail-Calibrated Debt Service Reserve Account (DSRA)
recommended_dsra_sizing.formula: CVaR 99% Annual Deficit (~13.1 months of senior debt service)

balance_sheet_discrepancy_max.name: Maximum Balance Sheet Discrepancy Across Projections

guardrail_audit_rules.description: Assets must strictly equal Liabilities plus Equity across all projection horizons.
guardrail_audit_rules.remediation_guidance: Verify that VAT credit and financing facilities are balanced across CFO, CFI, and CFF.

guardrail_audit_rules.rule_name: Hospitality Statutory VAT Rate Audit (10% vs 21%)
guardrail_audit_rules.description: Lodging and restaurant services must be taxed at 10.0%, NOT the general 21.0% rate.
guardrail_audit_rules.remediation_guidance: Applying 21% VAT creates a false insolvency trap (-€152k). Recalibrate to Ley 37/1992 Art. 91.

guardrail_audit_rules.rule_name: CapEx Deductible VAT Recognized as Fiscal Asset
guardrail_audit_rules.description: The €152,250 input VAT on CapEx must be booked as a tax receivable asset, not expensed as an operating loss.
guardrail_audit_rules.remediation_guidance: Recognize Modelo 303/390 deductible tax asset on Balance Sheet with bridge financing.

guardrail_audit_rules.rule_name: Segovia Hospitality Collective Agreement Wage Compliance
guardrail_audit_rules.description: Labor costs must reflect statutory wage tables + 35% employer Social Security contributions.
guardrail_audit_rules.remediation_guidance: Ensure 3 headcount (Head Chef, Assistant Cook, Housekeeping) meet BOCyL salary grades.

guardrail_audit_rules.rule_name: Year 1 Debt Service Coverage Ratio Covenant
guardrail_audit_rules.description: Year 1 DSCR must meet or exceed the mandatory institutional bank covenant of 1.25x.
guardrail_audit_rules.remediation_guidance: If DSCR drops below 1.25x, sponsor must inject additional equity or renegotiate grace period.

guardrail_audit_rules.description: Cash balance must remain positive at all times during the winter trough under the revolving credit facility.
guardrail_audit_rules.remediation_guidance: Activate €50k revolving facility or increase initial launch cash cushion.

guardrail_audit_rules.rule_name: Systemic Downside Tail Risk DSRA Backstop
guardrail_audit_rules.description: DSRA must be sized against Clayton copula CVaR 99% shortfall (€47,597), not naive 6-month rule (€21,775).
guardrail_audit_rules.remediation_guidance: Pledge €47,597 in escrow backed by incoming LEADER grant to protect senior debt against systemic defaults.

execution_status.audit_verdict: INSTITUTIONAL GRADE - VERIFIED FOR DATA ROOM DEPLOYMENT
